en: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}OAK POKéMON RESEARCH LAB
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}To make a complete guide on all\nthe POKéMON in the world…\pThat was my dream!

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}PROF. OAK may not look like much,\nbut he's the authority on POKéMON.\pMany POKéMON TRAINERS hold him in\nhigh regard.
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Family and friends?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}PROF. OAK reportedly lives with his\ngrandchildren, DAISY and {RIVAL}.

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Family and friends?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I hear OAK's taken a lot of
interest in you, child.\pThat old duff was once tough and
handsome.\pBut that was decades ago.
He's a shadow of his former self.

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}PROF. OAK is going to have his own\nradio show soon.\pThe program will be called PROF.\nOAK'S POKéMON SEMINAR.

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}If you show DAISY your POKéMON,\nshe can tell how much it likes you.\pOccasionally, she will even groom\na POKéMON for you.
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}But the person who is most liked by\nPOKéMON is DAISY, I think.

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}She was gently grooming POKéMON…\nShe was a little angel.\pThat little girl's name…\nI think it was DAISY.
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Family and friends?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}PROF. OAK reportedly lives with his\ngrandchildren, DAISY and {RIVAL}.

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}A girl from PALLET TOWN, DAISY,\nshe enjoys TEA every day.\pShe visits the CELADON DEPT. STORE\nto buy some TEA.
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}There's a rumor…\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}The Spring POKéMON CONTEST's\nGrand Champion is DAISY OAK of\lPALLET TOWN!
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}PEWTER CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BROCK\lThe Rock-Solid POKéMON TRAINER!

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}My rock-hard willpower is evident
in even my POKéMON.\pMy POKéMON are all rock hard and
have true-grit determination.\pThat's right - my POKéMON are all
the ROCK type!

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}There aren't many serious POKéMON
TRAINERS here.\pThey're all like BUG CATCHERS,
you know, just hobbyists.\pBut PEWTER GYM's BROCK isn't like
that, not one bit.

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}BROCK is cool. He's not just tough.\nPeople like and respect him.\pI want to become a GYM LEADER\nlike him.

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Hi, I'm excavating for fossils here\nunder MT. MOON.\pSometimes, BROCK of PEWTER GYM\nlends me a hand.
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}BROCK rarely laughs, but is said to\nbe unable to stop if he starts.
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}CERULEAN CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: MISTY\lThe Tomboyish Mermaid!
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}My policy is an all-out offensive\nwith WATER-type POKéMON!
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}MISTY is a TRAINER who's going to\nkeep improving.\pShe won't lose to someone like you!

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}There's a rumor…\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Strong TRAINERS and WATER POKéMON\nare common sights in these parts.\pThey say that MISTY of the\nCERULEAN GYM trains here.
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}There's a rumor…\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}This cape is a famous date spot.\pMISTY, the GYM LEADER, has high\nhopes about this place.
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}There's a rumor…\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}MISTY is said to worship LORELEI\nof the ELITE FOUR.
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}VERMILION CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: LT. SURGE\lThe Lightning American!
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I tell you, kid, electric POKéMON\nsaved me during the war!
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}When I was in the Army, LT. SURGE\nwas my strict CO.\pHe was a hard taskmaster.
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}LT. SURGE was always famous for\nhis cautious nature in the Army.
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}LT. SURGE installed the traps in\nthe GYM himself.\pHe set up double locks everywhere.

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}There's a rumor…\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}LT. SURGE is rumored to have been\na pilot while home in America.\pHe used the electricity generated\nby POKéMON to power his plane.
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}CELADON CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: ERIKA\lThe Nature-Loving Princess!
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I am a student of the art of\nflower arranging.\pMy POKéMON are solely of the\nGRASS type.
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Our LEADER ERIKA might be quiet,\nbut she's famous around here.

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}We only use GRASS-type POKéMON at\nour GYM.\pWhy? We also use them for making\nflower arrangements!
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I would never collect POKéMON if\nthey were unattractive.
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}There's a rumor…\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Rumor has it that if you peek into\nCELADON GYM, you can often\lsee ERIKA snoozing.
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}FUCHSIA CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: KOGA\lThe Poisonous Ninja Master
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Despair to the creeping horror of\nPOISON-type POKéMON!

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Even though I've lost, I will keep\ntraining according to the teachings\lof KOGA, my ninja master.

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Family and friends?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}My father is the GYM LEADER of\nthis town.\pI'm training to use POISON POKéMON\nas well as my father.

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}There's a rumor…\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}KOGA is said to have a thorough\nknowledge of medicine.\pHe even concocts medicine to nurse\nhis POKéMON to health.

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}The SAFARI ZONE's huge, wouldn't
you say?\pFUCHSIA's GYM LEADER, KOGA, 
patrols the grounds every so often.\pThanks to him, we can play here
knowing that we're safe.
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}SAFFRON CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: SABRINA\lThe Master of PSYCHIC POKéMON!
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}You know about a girl GYM LEADER\nin SAFFRON CITY?\pShe uses PSYCHIC-type POKéMON,\nright?

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I have had psychic powers since\nI was a child.\pIt started when a spoon I\ncarelessly tossed, bent.
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I dislike battling, but if you wish,\nI will show you my powers!
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}There's a rumor…\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}People say that SABRINA can\ncommunicate with her POKéMON\lduring battle without speaking.
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}SABRINA just wiped out the KARATE\nMASTER next door.
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}CINNABAR ISLAND POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BLAINE\lThe Hotheaded Quiz Master!
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}My fiery POKéMON are all rough\nand ready with intense heat!\pThey incinerate all challengers!

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Our LEADER, BLAINE, became lost
in the mountains but good.\pNight fell when a fiery bird
POKéMON appeared.\pIts light allowed BLAINE to find
his way down safely.

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}CINNABAR GYM's BLAINE is quite the\nodd fellow.\pHe's lived on the island since way\nbefore the LAB was built.
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Family and friends?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}It's a photo of BLAINE and\nMR. FUJI.\pThey're standing shoulder to\nshoulder with big grins.
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}There's a rumor…\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}BLAINE is said to remove his dark\nshades only when he is thinking up\lnew quiz questions.
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I am LORELEI of the ELITE FOUR.
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}No one can best me when it comes\nto icy POKéMON.

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Where was this person born?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}We've had a great and powerful\nTRAINER grow up on this island.\pI bet even you'd know her.\nIt's LORELEI of the ELITE FOUR!
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Known for her logical, calculated,\nand cool battling style, LORELEI\lhas a surprising secret!

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Did you know that LORELEI has lots\nand lots of stuffed dolls?\pEvery time she comes back to\nFOUR ISLAND, her collection grows!

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}The LAPRAS she has, I imagine it
to be the one she met as a child.\pI believe it was in ICEFALL CAVE
that she caught it.\pPerhaps that POKéMON has been with
her ever since.
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I am BRUNO of the ELITE FOUR!
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I've lived and trained with my\nfighting POKéMON!
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}BRUNO apparently joined the ELITE\nFOUR out of his burning ambition to\lbattle the best TRAINERS.

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}BRUNO, who's a senior ahead of me,\nvisits the SPA on occasion.\pHe comes to rehab injuries, both\nhis own and his POKéMON's.

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}There's a rumor…\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}He's one of the ELITE FOUR.\nHis name is BRUNO.\pHe went away disappointed when he\nfound out that they were all sold\lout of Rage Candybars.
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Family and friends?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Even BRUNO…\nHe trained with a fellow by the\lname of BRAWLY before.
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I am AGATHA of the ELITE FOUR.
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}AGATHA's GHOST-type POKéMON are\nhorrifically terrifying in toughness.

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}That old lady's also got a really\nshort fuse, too.\pIt doesn't take anything to get\nthat scary lady hollering.
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}There's a rumor…\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}In her youth, AGATHA and PROF.\nOAK were rivals who vied for\lsupremacy as TRAINERS.

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Family and friends?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I hear OAK's taken a lot of
interest in you, child.\pThat old duff was once tough and
handsome.\pBut that was decades ago.
He's a shadow of his former self.
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Take AGATHA, for example.\pShe set a record for being the\noldest-ever ELITE FOUR member.
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I lead the ELITE FOUR.\pYou can call me LANCE the dragon\nTRAINER.

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}You know that dragons are
mythical POKéMON.\pThey're hard to catch and raise,
but their powers are superior.\pThey're virtually indestructible.
There's no being clever with them.
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}He stands for justice!\nHe's cool, and yet passionate!\lHe's the greatest, LANCE!

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}There's a rumor…\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}We have a customer, LANCE, who\noccasionally comes.\pHe always buys capes.\pI wonder… Does he have many\nidentical capes at home?
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Family and friends?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}LANCE's grandfather is thought to\nbe the elder of a famous clan of\ldragon masters.
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Family and friends?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}From what I've heard, LANCE has\na cousin who's a GYM LEADER\lsomewhere far away.

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}After all, BILL's world-famous as a\nPOKéMANIAC.\pHe invented the POKéMON Storage\nSystem on PC, too.
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}BILL has lots of POKéMON!\nHe collects rare ones, too!
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}He's my grandson!\pHe always liked collecting things,\neven as a child!

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}BILL is a POKéMANIAC, so he loves\nevery kind.\pApparently, the first one he caught\nwas an ABRA.

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Family and friends?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}BILL's hometown is GOLDENROD CITY,\nwhere his folks still live.\pI've heard that it's quite the\nfestive, bustling city.
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}There's a rumor…\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Apparently, BILL simply can't\nstomach milk at all.
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}He's really kind.\pHe looks after abandoned and\norphaned POKéMON.

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}This old guy marched right up to
our HIDEOUT.\pThen, he starts ranting about how
TEAM ROCKET's abusing POKéMON.\pSo, we're just talking it over as
adults.

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}POKéMON FAN MAGAZINE\nMonthly Grand Prize Drawing!\pThe application form is…\pGone! It's been clipped out.\nSomeone must have applied already.
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}There's a rumor…\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I hear that MR. FUJI's not from\nthese parts originally, either.
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Family and friends?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}It's a photo of BLAINE and\nMR. FUJI.\pThey're standing shoulder to\nshoulder with big grins.

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Editor: The shy MR. FUJI turned\ndown our interview requests.\pHe is a kindly man who is adored\nand respected in LAVENDER TOWN.

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}TEAM ROCKET captures POKéMON from\naround the world.\pThey're important tools for keeping\nour criminal enterprise going.\pI am the leader, GIOVANNI!
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Those thugs that took over our\nbuilding…\pTheir BOSS said he was looking for\nstrong POKéMON.
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}TEAM ROCKET's BOSS is terribly\ncruel!\pTo him, POKéMON are just tools to\nbe used.
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Welcome to my hideout!\pIt shall be so until I can restore\nTEAM ROCKET to its former glory.
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Blow me away! GIOVANNI was the\nGYM LEADER of VIRIDIAN?
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Family and friends?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}You… You're not GIOVANNI's kid,\nare you?\pNo, that can't be right.\nGIOVANNI's kid has red hair.

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: PROF. OAK
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Why do POKéMON compete and battle
so hard for you?\pThey do so because they can see
the love and trust you have\ltowards POKéMON.\pNever forget that.

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: DAISY
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}While I was comfortably enjoying
my tea breaks, you've grown very\lskilled and powerful.\pI hope you'll remain a good rival
to my little brother.

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: BROCK
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}In this big world of ours, there
must be many tough TRAINERS.\pLet's both keep training and
making ourselves stronger!

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: MISTY
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I'm going to keep training here at
this GYM.\pWhen I get better, I'd love to hit
the road and travel.

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: LT. SURGE
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Hey, kid!
You electrified me in our battle!\pI didn't know that there were
gutsy TRAINERS like you.\pIt made me change my mind about
you!

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: ERIKA
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I am so glad that there are strong
TRAINERS like you.\pThat awareness alone inspires and
motivates me to try harder.\pPlease visit me again.
Zzz…

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: KOGA\nTo: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}You and I, we must both set our\nsights higher and work towards\lmeeting our challenges.\pNow, I must go train my daughter.

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: SABRINA
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}The love you have towards your
POKéMON…\pIt was a power that was never
bested by my psychic power.

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: BLAINE
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}My fire POKéMON!
They'll become even more powerful!\pAnd now, a quiz. How many kinds of
FIRE-type POKéMON are there?

{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: LORELEI
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I needed to thank you for your
help.\pBut that has nothing to do with our
